program.section_heading: Requirements for the Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Apply OSHA 29 CFR 1926 safety standards and demonstrate safe work practices in simulated carpentry environments.
Identify and respond to construction site hazards, including proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and understanding of Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and GHS pictograms.
Demonstrate basic carpentry skills in framing, foundations, and layout through hands-on lab activities.
Describe the roles, structures, and benefits of unionized carpentry trades, and articulate pathways to apprenticeship and career advancement.
Communicate and collaborate effectively in team-based work environments, demonstrating reliability, professionalism, and respect for diversity in the trades.
Develop a personalized career and training plan aligned with their interests, aptitudes, and entry into union pre-apprenticeship programs or the construction workforce.
